abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform an upward slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.name: Musou Isshin
abilities.caveat: Plunging in this stance is only possible with Xianyun on the team; the plunge frames shown assume that setup.
abilities.description: While in the Musou Isshin state, the Raiden Shogun wields her tachi in battle. Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks are infused with Electro DMG (cannot be overridden) and count as Elemental Burst DMG.
_curatorNotes: [A7] Stored plunge frames are the low-plunge (Xianyun-assisted) values. Unused high-plunge: hitmark 51f (48+3), swap 61.

abilities.name: Transcendence: Baleful Omen
abilities.caveat: The burst DMG bonus scales with each member's own burst energy cost, so it differs per party member; the timeline shows the buff window but not a single value.
_curatorNotes: A6 rigor 2026-07-12: burst DMG bonus per-energy corrected ≈0.35% → ≈0.30% (T10) (gcsim skillBurstBonus[9]=0.003; sidecar 0.30% Per Energy)
[A7] Per-member value = mult × that member's burst energy cost; ≈0.30% per energy at T10 per the existing A6 rigor note.
abilities.description:
The Raiden Shogun unveils a shard of her Euthymia, dealing Electro DMG to nearby opponents, and granting nearby party members the Eye of Stormy Judgment.

Eye of Stormy Judgment
·When characters with this buff attack and deal DMG to opponents, the Eye will unleash a coordinated attack, dealing AoE Electro DMG at the opponent's position. One coordinated attack every 0.9s per party.
·Characters who gain the Eye of Stormy Judgment will have their Elemental Burst DMG increased based on the Energy Cost of their Elemental Burst during the Eye's 25s duration.

abilities.name: Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu
abilities.caveat: Not modeled: Resolve stack count or the resulting DMG bonus.
abilities.description:
Gathering truths unnumbered and wishes uncounted, the Raiden Shogun unleashes the Musou no Hitotachi and deals AoE Electro DMG, using Musou Isshin in combat for a certain duration afterward. The DMG dealt by Musou no Hitotachi and Musou Isshin attacks is increased based on Chakra Desiderata Resolve stacks consumed.

Musou Isshin
While in this state, the Raiden Shogun wields her tachi in battle. Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks are infused with Electro DMG (cannot be overridden) and count as Elemental Burst DMG.

Chakra Desiderata
When nearby party members (excluding Raiden) use their Elemental Bursts, the Raiden Shogun builds Resolve stacks based on the Energy Cost of those Bursts (max 60 stacks). Resolve stacks increase the DMG of the initial Musou no Hitotachi and Musou Isshin hits.

passives.name: Wishes Unnumbered
passives.description: When nearby party members gain Elemental Orbs or Particles, Chakra Desiderata gains 2 Resolve stacks. This effect can occur once every 3s.

passives.name: Enlightened One
passives.description:
Each 1% above 100% Energy Recharge that the Raiden Shogun possesses grants her:
·0.6% greater Energy restoration from Musou Isshin
·0.4% Electro DMG Bonus.

constellations.name: Ominous Inscription
constellations.description: Chakra Desiderata will gather Resolve even faster. When Electro characters use their Elemental Bursts, the Resolve gained is increased by 80%. When characters of other Elemental Types use their Elemental Bursts, the Resolve gained is increased by 20%.

constellations.name: Steelbreaker
constellations.description: While using Musou no Hitotachi and in the Musou Isshin state applied by Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu, the Raiden Shogun's attacks ignore 60% of opponents' DEF.

constellations.name: Shinkage Bygones
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Pledge of Propriety
constellations.description: When the Musou Isshin state applied by Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu expires, all nearby party members (excluding the Raiden Shogun) gain 30% bonus ATK for 10s.

constellations.name: Shogun's Descent
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Transcendence: Baleful Omen by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Wishbearer
constellations.caveat: Not modeled: the C6 CD reduction from Musou Isshin hits.
constellations.description:
While in the Musou Isshin state applied by Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu, attacks by the Raiden Shogun that are considered part of her Elemental Burst will decrease all nearby party members' (not including the Raiden Shogun herself) Elemental Burst CD by 1s when they hit opponents.
This effect can trigger once every 1s and can trigger a total of 5 times during Musou Isshin's duration.
_curatorNotes: [A7] C6 CD reduction detail: −1s to nearby party members' burst CD per burst-stance hit on an opponent, once per 1s, up to 5 times per stance. cooldownReduce is schema-only / parser-deferred.
